steps.path: Resume → the tag icon on a conversation
steps.headline: The line across the card is gone. With it gone, does one of the first three fit?
steps.notice: The line came from the Resume card itself, so it was in every version you saw — the first three included. It's removed here, and above the narrow-screen Resume panel too, which had the same line. Your pick also goes to the side panel and Projects preview.
steps.risk: If none fits, tell me what bothers you most and I'll aim the next round at that.

variants.label: Flat
variants.summary: "Note" and "Tags" labels, then everything laid flat in the card.

variants.label: Add on demand
variants.summary: The note, this session's tags and "+ Add tag"; the search and other tags appear when you press it. Shortest.
variants.risk: One more click to add a tag.

variants.label: One card
variants.summary: Note, tags and Pin together in a single inset card.
variants.risk: A card inside the Resume card.
